entities.summary: People's Revolution, a transformative movement in Grenada (1979–1983). Emerged from New Jewel Movement and Bishop establishes People's Revolutionary Government. Catalyzed Maurice Bishop executed by army faction — October 19, 1983 and US invades Grenada (Operation Urgent Fury) — October 25, 1983.
